# Pulse

> Pulse is a local-first, state-aware memory engine for AI agents: it
> retrieves the right remembered episode for the user's current state — not
> just the closest text match — shows why that memory surfaced, shows the
> continuity pack the next agent receives, and wipes on one command.
> Host-extracted structured capsules only, never raw transcripts, no backend
> model API keys by default. Developer preview; Claude Code-first; not
> production.

Primary install (Pulse Local Preview):
`npx @zbs-gg/pulse@preview init claude-code` then `pulse doctor` then
`pulse demo`. Requires Node 20+, Go toolchain, Claude Code CLI, and an
embedder (local MLX on Apple Silicon, or a Cohere key — doctor reports which
path is active). The demo seeds an isolated SIMULATED corpus and proves:
same query in three user states returns different justified episodes
(visible per-line reasons: state/anchor/emotion/date boosts), old anchors
beat recent noise, and the next-agent continuity pack matches the evidence.
`pulse demo --clean` erases the demo store. Doctor verdict is binary and
honest: "Pulse Local Preview ready." or "Pulse MCP fallback is ready. Full
retrieval is not enabled."

Safe Mode (fallback, not the product):
`claude mcp add pulse -- npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp` — keyword-recall
structured local store with inspect/wipe for machines that can't run the
engine. No benchmark claims apply to this mode.

## Docs

- [Agent install + safety instructions](AGENTS.md): the script an AI agent
  follows to audit, explain, install, run doctor + the stateful demo, and
  show the exit path.
- [README](README.md): product overview, install matrix, trust boundaries.
- [Known limitations](mcp/docs/developer-preview/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
- [Safe claims](mcp/docs/developer-preview/SAFE_CLAIMS.md)
- [Uninstall and wipe](mcp/docs/developer-preview/UNINSTALL_AND_WIPE.md)

## Packages

- [@zbs-gg/pulse on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zbs-gg/pulse): the
  one package — installer/CLI (init, doctor, demo, viewer) + MCP server
  (`pulse mcp`).
- [@zbs-gg/pulse-mcp on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zbs-gg/pulse-mcp):
  internal server component (low-level/dev artifact).

## Boundaries

- Not production ready; developer preview for technical users.
- Bench numbers (e.g. stateful R@3 0.419 on Emo.Bench v3) apply to the full
  engine only — never to Safe Mode keyword recall.
- No automatic chat import; ingest is host-extracted by default and bulk
  import is explicit, preview-first, opt-in.
